name: 404 Page
summary: Missing-resource composition with a required explanation, at least one target-owned recovery path, and canonical Empty State, Input, Button, and Link dependencies.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Container-responsive contextual root placed inside the single document-level main owned by a standalone target.

anatomy.name: core
anatomy.description: Canonical Empty State composition containing the explanation and optional primary recovery action.

anatomy.name: illustration
anatomy.description: Optional decorative Empty State illustration; essential information remains textual.

anatomy.name: code
anatomy.description: Optional visible status code hidden from accessibility because the required heading communicates the state.

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading and render precondition.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Non-empty explanatory recovery message and render precondition.

anatomy.name: primaryAction
anatomy.description: Optional visually primary native destination composed from canonical Button.

anatomy.name: search
anatomy.description: Optional named native search form with target-owned action, method, request, and result lifecycle.

anatomy.name: searchField
anatomy.description: Canonical Input composition with a visible label, named search field, and associated message.

anatomy.name: searchAction
anatomy.description: Visible native submit action composed from canonical Button.

anatomy.name: links
anatomy.description: Optional named navigation containing additional target-owned recovery destinations.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: A real native recovery destination composed from canonical Link.

anatomy.name: suggestionsHeading
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading naming suggested destinations.

anatomy.name: suggestionList
anatomy.description: Native list preserving target-authored suggestion order.

anatomy.name: suggestionItem
anatomy.description: Single passive list item containing a target-owned destination.

anatomy.name: suggestionLink
anatomy.description: Real suggested destination composed from canonical Link.

states.name: default
states.description: Required explanation with at least one useful recovery path.

states.name: withSearch
states.description: Optional target-owned recovery search is present.

states.name: withRecoveryLinks
states.description: Primary and additional real recovery destinations are present.

states.name: withSuggestions
states.description: Optional target-owned suggested destinations are present.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: A valid renderer requires a non-empty visible heading and message; adapters omit the complete component when either is absent.

behavior.name: recoveryRequirement
behavior.description: A rendered composition provides at least one useful recovery path across search, recovery destinations, or suggestions.

behavior.name: emptyStateComposition
attributes: aria-hidden="true" on decorative illustration and redundant code
behavior.description: The explanatory core composes canonical Empty State and retains no intrinsic live-region or error role.

behavior.name: searchComposition
behavior.description: Optional search composes canonical Input and Button; the target owns query handling, requests, results, pending, errors, retry, analytics, and persistence.

behavior.name: nativeDestinations
behavior.description: Recovery and suggested destinations use truthful native links and never cancel placeholder fragment navigation.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: A named inline-size container and intrinsic list tracks adapt the component independently from the browser viewport and Studio host.

properties.name: illustration
properties.description: Optional decorative Empty State media; essential information remains textual.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Optional visible status code hidden from accessibility as redundant presentation.

properties.name: search
properties.description: Optional target-owned native search form composed from canonical Input and Button.

properties.name: recoveryLinks
properties.description: Optional visually primary and additional real target-owned recovery destinations.

properties.name: suggestions
properties.description: Optional target-owned heading and native list of real suggested destinations.

accessibility: Require a non-empty visible heading and message and place the composition inside the single document-level main owned by a standalone target.
Provide at least one useful recovery path and use descriptive real href destinations without cancelling native navigation.
Treat the optional illustration as decorative and hide the redundant visible status code from accessibility.
Compose optional search from a named native form, visible Input label, named search field, associated message, and visible submit Button.
Render suggestions as a labelled native list and retain meaningful target-authored order and destination labels.
Preserve canonical dependency focus, keyboard, touch, forced-colors, reduced-motion, validation, controlled/uncontrolled, and accessible-name behavior.

web.notes: Contextual native composition implemented in components/css/pages.css and the shared Exhibit/Studio renderer.

shopify.notes: Existing JSON 404 template maps target-owned response, routes and search into canonical P1 and dependency classes; ADR 0236 maps the standalone page heading to H1 through canonical Empty State.
